pass1.passed_sub: SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, Container Scan, SBOM Generation, Artifact Signing, Approval Gate, Audit Trail

checks.name: SBOM Policy Enforcement
checks.fix: An SscaOrchestration step exists (SBOM is generated) but there is no SscaEnforcement step in the pipeline. The SBOM is produced but never evaluated against a component allow/deny policy. Fix: Add an SscaEnforcement step in the Supply_Chain step group immediately after RAISE_Gate_2_SBOM_Generation. Policy: sbom_policy_enforcement.rego

checks.name: IaC Scanning
checks.fix: No Infrastructure-as-Code stages detected in this pipeline. Control is not applicable.

checks.name: OPA Policy Set (On Run)
checks.fix: No OPA Policy Set with action=onrun (Error and Exit) is attached. RAISE_2_0_Pipeline_Governance is onsave only; RAISE_CVE_Zero_Tolerance is onstepstart — neither qualifies as an on-run gate. Fix: Create a Policy Set with action: onrun and attach RAISE_Block_on_Critical_CVE and RAISE_2_0_Required_Gates policies. Policy: opa_onrun_required.rego

checks.name: Severity Thresholds
checks.fix: All STO scanner steps (Gitleaks, Semgrep, OWASP, OsvScanner, AquaTrivy, ZAP) have failureStrategies: Ignore applied and none specify fail_on_severity. Critical and High vulnerabilities will not block the pipeline. Fix: Add advanced.fail_on_severity: critical to each scanner step spec and remove the blanket Ignore failure strategy. Policy: fail_on_severity_required.rego

checks.name: Evidence Export
checks.fix: Security scan results, SBOM JSON, and policy evaluation outputs are not explicitly persisted as versioned evidence artifacts. Step logs are transient. The AGR Inline Agent provides assessment evidence but does not substitute for the pipeline's own scan result exports. Fix: Add an upload step (e.g., S3Upload or GCSUpload) after the scan and SBOM steps to persist artifacts to a durable evidence store. Policy: evidence_export_required.rego

checks.name: Build Tool Chain Integrity
checks.fix: Two Tier-1 artifact-producing tool pinning failures detected: (1) BuildAndPushDockerRegistry step uses niwc/raise-demo:0.0.<+pipeline.sequenceId> — a dynamically-computed floating tag with no image digest. (2) Run: Application_Build uses node:20-alpine — a floating tag with no @sha256: digest pin. SolarWinds-class risk: a compromised builder image injects malicious code that passes all downstream scans. Fix: Pin both to image@sha256:<digest> and verify with cosign before use. Policy: build_tool_integrity.rego

policies.name: sbom_policy_enforcement.rego
policies.desc: Require SscaEnforcement step after SscaOrchestration SBOM generation

policies.name: opa_onrun_required.rego
policies.desc: Enforce OPA Policy Set with action=onrun on every pipeline run

policies.name: fail_on_severity_required.rego
policies.desc: All STO scanner steps must have fail_on_severity set to critical or high

policies.name: build_tool_integrity.rego
policies.desc: Artifact-producing steps must pin images to sha256 digest — no floating tags

policies.name: evidence_export_required.rego
policies.desc: Pipelines with scanners must export SBOM and scan results to durable storage
